objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content that undergoes creation, editing, approval, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: A short code prefix assigned to each document type (e.g., RL for Guideline, PO for Policy)

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned to each document of its type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or heading of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current workflow state of the document such as In Editing, Under Review, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The revision level of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The body or substantive material of the document

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents related to this document

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: System applications referenced or relevant to the document

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The companies or areas to which the document applies

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type, with embedded TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document for which the template is designed

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The file format of the template

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document linked to a main document that is automatically released with the main document and triggers versioning when created, modified, or archived.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The file or document content

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The release status aligned with the main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary material attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and does not create new versions of the main document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The supplementary material or information

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to a document that does not affect the document's version history until accepted and implemented.

attributes.name: proposed_change
attributes.description: The modification or update being suggested

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the proposal such as Pending, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in defined roles such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The function assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: The specific permissions granted to the user

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users organized together for the purpose of assigning common authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifier of the user group

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: The users belonging to the group

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic record documenting that a user has completed a workflow task such as creation, review, or release of a document.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The user who provided the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the signature was applied

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The phase of the process during which the signature was collected

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained record of users and user groups who should receive a document and/or provide acknowledgement upon its release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Either Distribution by Email or Distribution for Acknowledgement

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: The users or user groups included in the distribution

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An activity assigned to a user within the document approval process, such as creation, review, or release.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The nature of the task such as Creator, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: The user responsible for completing the task

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the task is pending or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manual request to confirm or update the continued validity of a document.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document for which validity is being checked

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the request such as Pending or Completed

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Whether processing involves releasers only or includes authors, reviewers, and releasers

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity, removing it from active circulation.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being invalidated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the invalidation process

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Whether processing involves releasers only or includes initiator, reviewers, and releasers

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated and archived document to active status.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The archived document being reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: The user requesting reactivation, must be from Business Admin group

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the reactivation request

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of confirmation by a user that they have reviewed and understood a document distributed for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: The person confirming the acknowledgement

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being acknowledged

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the acknowledgement was confirmed

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement is pending or confirmed

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific interface displaying documents and tasks relevant to the user based on their permissions and distribution assignments.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The user role for which the dashboard is configured

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The documents and tasks displayed

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation or search function providing filtered views of documents and their status according to selected criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The category of report such as Status Report or Search Report

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: The criteria used to filter results

attributes.name: target_role
attributes.description: The user role for which the report is designed

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group with read access to archived and invalidated documents for historical and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Users with archive access rights

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group with authority to create reactivation requests for invalidated documents.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Users with business administration authority

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document that must undergo its own approval process before becoming visible to readers.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translation

attributes.name: original_document
attributes.description: The document being translated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The approval status of the translated version

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate organizational instance or tenant in a multi-client system, each with its own document visibility and management settings.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the client

attributes.name: document_visibility
attributes.description: Which documents are visible or hidden in this client

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object to the system with selection of a corresponding document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created

attributes.name: template_selection
attributes.description: Optional selection of a predefined template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or properties including metadata, attributes, and substantive material.

evts.name: upload_document_content
evts.description: Addition of external files or documents to a document object.

evts.name: apply_template
evts.description: Selection and application of a predefined document structure during document creation.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template being applied

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Entry and updating of standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes grouped in categories.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of a document from its source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group-related and person-related authorization roles such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, or Releaser.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The authorization role being assigned

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: The user or group receiving the authorization

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Proposal of a suggested modification to an existing document without affecting the current version or version history.

attributes.name: proposed_change
attributes.description: The modification being suggested

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Decision to implement a pending change proposal, which triggers creation of a new document version.

attributes.name: change_proposal
attributes.description: The proposal being scheduled

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Documentation of editing and completion of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document attached to a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving, which triggers a new version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of supplementary material to a document that is not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: modify_additional_information
evts.description: Editing of supplementary material attached to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Removal of supplementary material from a document without triggering versioning.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start of the 3-step workflow for document approval consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_as_author
evts.description: Electronic signature by the registered author confirming document creation in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assessment of document content by reviewers according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: sign_as_reviewer
evts.description: Electronic signature by assigned reviewers confirming completion of the review task.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by assigned releasers.

evts.name: sign_as_releaser
evts.description: Electronic signature by assigned releasers confirming document release and publication.

evts.name: reject_in_review
evts.description: Denial of approval during the review step, which cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_in_release
evts.description: Denial of approval during the release step, which cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new editing version of a released document that is being revised.

evts.name: archive_previous_attachments
evts.description: Archiving of attachments from a previous version that are no longer relevant in a new version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document making it visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported review and approval of a validity extension request.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation of extended validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date by the default period.

evts.name: approve_validity_extension
evts.description: Authorization confirmation of extended validity by assigned releasers or workflow participants.

evts.name: decline_validity_extension
evts.description: Determination that a document requires revision or invalidation instead of validity extension.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being invalidated

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported review and approval of an override request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of a document as Out of Force and archiving for a defined period.

evts.name: sign_override_request
evts.description: Electronic signature by assigned participants approving document invalidation.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Withdrawal of document access rights from users and groups except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiation of a request to restore a previously invalidated and archived document to active status.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: The user from Business Admin group creating the request

evts.name: process_reactivation_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported review and approval of a reactivation request.

evts.name: restore_document_version
evts.description: Creation of a new version of a reactivated document with retained metadata and properties from the invalidated version.

evts.name: restore_authorization
evts.description: Reinstatement of document access rights according to maintained attributes after reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_attachments
evts.description: Restoration of attachments archived with an invalidated document during reactivation.

evts.name: create_distribution_list
evts.description: Definition of user groups or persons who should receive notification upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Either Distribution by Email or Distribution for Acknowledgement

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Updating of user groups and persons in a document's distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to assigned users and user groups upon document release.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic request for active confirmation of document acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Email-based workflow task requesting recipients to actively confirm document understanding.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a user that they have reviewed and understood a distributed document.

evts.name: view_dashboard
evts.description: Access to a role-specific interface displaying relevant documents and tasks based on user permissions and distribution.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The user role accessing the dashboard

evts.name: generate_reader_status_report
evts.description: Production of an evaluation report of instructions with additional information for reader role.

evts.name: generate_author_search_report
evts.description: Production of an evaluation report of documents in editing status for author role.

evts.name: generate_author_status_report
evts.description: Production of a status report of documents with revision cycles for author role using traffic light system.

evts.name: generate_workflow_status_report
evts.description: Production of a report evaluating current workflow status of documents for author role.

evts.name: generate_acknowledgement_report
evts.description: Production of a report listing all acknowledgements filtered by status for author role.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of a language-dependent version of a released document in another language.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language for translation

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Assessment of translated document content by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a translated document version.

evts.name: sign_translation
evts.description: Electronic signature confirming completion of translation review or release task.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Creation of a new document in a specific client as a local addition or extension to an original document.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client where the local document is created

evts.name: reference_document
evts.description: Creation of a reference link between documents to indicate relationships.

attributes.name: referenced_document
attributes.description: The document being referenced

evts.name: assign_document_to_client
evts.description: Specification of which clients can view a document in a multi-client system.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client for which visibility is being set

evts.name: hide_document_from_client
evts.description: Specification that a document is not visible to users in a particular client.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client from which the document is hidden

o2o.description: Documents can reference other documents as related or supplementary materials
Each document type can have one or more templates that define document structure
Attachments are controlled documents linked to main documents
Additional information is supplementary material attached to documents
Change proposals belong to and describe modifications for specific documents
Documents have visibility and access settings defined per client in multi-client systems
Language versions are translated versions of released documents
Users are members of user groups that define collective authorizations
Archive group is a specialized user group with read access to archived documents
Business admin group is a specialized user group that creates reactivation requests
Documents have distribution lists that define recipients for notification and acknowledgement
